info.title: Needly API
info.description: Backend API for Needly, a real-time shared shopping and household coordination application.

get.description: Returns the health status of the API.
Exposes application metrics in Prometheus text format. Requires authentication in production mode.
Returns a summary of collected trace spans. Requires authentication in production mode.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or revoked refresh token

post.description: Revokes refresh tokens. If a refresh_token is provided in the body, only that token is revoked. Otherwise all tokens for the user are revoked.

400.description: Invalid request body or permission denied

get.summary: List shopping lists for a household
List items in a shopping list

post.summary: Add an item to a shopping list

get.summary: List shopping history for a list
List shopping history for a household
List recent notifications for a household

get.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection scoped to a specific household.

refresh_token.description: Optional. If provided, only this token is revoked. Otherwise all tokens for the user are revoked.
